description: Returns a patient's clinical history filtered by clinical type (e.g. DISEASE, SYMPTOM, ALLERGY, CONDITION).

query_parameters.type: string, optional - filters by clinical_master.clinical_type (DISEASE | SYMPTOM | ALLERGY | CONDITION)

validation: patient must exist and belong to organization + branch
type, if provided, filters joined clinical_master.clinical_type

errors.condition: patient does not exist / not in organization+branch scope

notes: clinical_master.clinical_type is a free-text VARCHAR(30) with no CHECK constraint restricting it to DISEASE/SYMPTOM/ALLERGY/CONDITION - those four values are documented as a comment in database/schema/003_patient_clinical_data.sql but are not enforced by the database.
